lines.text: Josiah kept the Passover in Jerusalem and appointed the priests to their duties.
Josiah told the Levites to put the holy ark in the temple built by Saul.
Josiah gave 30,000 lambs and goats plus 3,000 bulls from his own flocks and herds.
They roasted the Passover animals on the fire, and the Levites made preparations for the priests, the descendants of Aaron.
No Passover like Josiah's had been observed in Israel since the days of Elijah the prophet.
